lines.say: Do muscles grow on rest days?
Training is the signal. The building happens after, while you recover.
After a hard workout, muscle building stays switched on for about one to two days.
For beginners, the first part of that is mostly repairing damage. Real growth takes over as your body adapts.
So rest days aren't lazy days. That's when you build, as long as you eat protein and sleep.
But you don't need many. Training each muscle about twice a week keeps the signal coming.
